# Week Meal Plan

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A note representing the planned meals for a given week, aggregating daily meal plan entries.

## Scope note

Part of the Meal domain within the Calendar hierarchy; relates to Meal and Recipe concepts at the week granularity.

## Broader

- [Week Cluster](../WeekCluster/) — partitive (ISO 25964)
